Measures
This data set by Lincoln, Tip, and De La Fuente Garcia contains the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale (Cronbach’s α = 0.9), nine items from the shortened Attachment-Related Anxiety subscale from the Experiences in Close Relationships Scale (Cronbach’s α = 0.94), and the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (Cronbach’s α = 0.85) to create a comprehensive measure of attachment anxiety.


Data Analysis Strategy
The data for items 5, 9, and 11 in the Social Interaction Anxiety Scale responses, and 2, 5, 6, 8, and 9 in the Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale were reverse keyed.
